blocks.html: Family Fishing Charters in San José del Cabo
Private Fishing Adventures for Families in Los Cabos

Planning a family fishing trip in San José del Cabo?

At Exotic Fish Cabo, we help families enjoy private sportfishing adventures departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina, Mexico.

Whether you're introducing your children to fishing, traveling with teenagers, or looking for an outdoor activity the whole family can enjoy, our private fishing charters offer a personalized experience.

You don't need previous fishing experience. Our local captains and crews can introduce beginners to the equipment, explain basic fishing techniques, and help everyone participate according to their comfort and ability.

All trips are private, with the selected boat reserved exclusively for your group.

Why Choose a Private Family Fishing Charter?

Your Own Boat, Your Own Group

A private charter means private fishing boat, you won't share the boat with unrelated passengers.

This gives your family the opportunity to enjoy the experience together and discuss your preferences with the crew before departure.

Fishing for Beginners and Experienced Anglers

Some family members may have years of fishing experience, while others may be holding a fishing rod for the first time.

Our crew can provide assistance with the equipment and explain the fishing techniques used during the trip.

The fishing plan will depend on your preferences, the selected boat, weather conditions, and seasonal fish activity.

A Memorable Experience Beyond Catching Fish

A day on the water offers more than fishing.

Families can enjoy the coastal scenery around San José del Cabo, learn about local marine life, and share an adventure together.

Fishing results vary, and catching a particular species can never be guaranteed.

Which Fishing Charter Is Best for Your Family?

6-Hour Private Fishing Charter

Starting at $350 USD per boat for selected 1–2 guest options.

A 6-hour trip can be a practical choice for families who prefer not to spend an entire day offshore.

This option may suit beginners, couples with children, or smaller groups looking for a manageable introduction to Cabo fishing.

Your captain will consider sea conditions and fishing opportunities when planning the trip.

8-Hour Private Fishing Charter

Starting at $600 USD per boat.

An 8-hour charter offers additional time on the water.

It may appeal to families with older children, teenagers, and adults who want a longer fishing adventure or additional offshore opportunities.

Final pricing depends on the selected boat, group size, and charter details.

Important: A longer fishing trip is not necessarily better for every family. Consider your children's ages, comfort on boats, and experience with ocean conditions before choosing.

Choosing the Right Fishing Boat for Your Family

Every family has different needs.

Some prefer a smaller private boat for a couple or small group. Others need more passenger space, additional seating, shade, or onboard facilities.

Before booking, consider:

  • Number of adults and children

  • Children's ages

  • Previous boating or fishing experience

  • Preferred trip duration

  • Possible seasickness concerns

  • Shade, seating, and restroom requirements

  • Maximum passenger capacity

  • Appropriate safety equipment

Not every boat offers the same amenities or accommodates every age group.

Tell us about your family before making a reservation so we can help you compare suitable options.

What Fish Can Families Catch in San José del Cabo?

The waters around San José del Cabo offer different fishing opportunities throughout the year.

Depending on the season and ocean conditions, possible targets include:

Roosterfish: A distinctive coastal game fish known for its striking dorsal fin and powerful fight.

Jack Crevalle: A strong inshore fish that can provide exciting action.

Sierra Mackerel: A seasonal coastal species that may be available on suitable inshore trips.

Dorado (Mahi-Mahi): A colorful offshore game fish known for fast strikes and acrobatic fights.

Yellowfin Tuna: A powerful offshore species that may be targeted on suitable trips.

Marlin, wahoo, snapper, and other species may also be encountered depending on the season, fishing location, and charter selected.

Your captain will recommend fishing techniques and locations based on current conditions. No specific catch is guaranteed.

Is Fishing in Cabo Safe for Children?

Safety should always come first when planning a family fishing trip.

Before booking, tell us the ages of all children and discuss the available boat options.

Children must be supervised by accompanying adults throughout the charter.

Appropriately sized life jackets, applicable age restrictions, boat capacity, and other safety requirements must be confirmed before departure.

Ocean conditions can change, so your captain may adjust the fishing plan or make decisions based on weather and safety.

What Should Families Bring on a Fishing Trip?

Preparing in advance helps everyone feel more comfortable.

We recommend:

  • Sun-protective clothing and hats

  • Sunglasses and appropriate sunscreen

  • Comfortable, non-slip footwear

  • A light jacket for cooler mornings

  • Personal medications when needed

  • Seasickness preparation if appropriate

  • Water and snacks if not included in your package

  • A waterproof pouch for phones and valuables

Fishing rods, reels, and basic tackle are provided.

Food, drinks, fishing licenses, live bait, and other services vary by charter. Confirm the inclusions before booking.

For more advice, read our complete What to Bring on a Fishing Charter in Cabo checklist.

Where Do Our Family Fishing Charters Depart?

All Exotic Fish Cabo trips depart exclusively from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, Baja California Sur, Mexico.

Departures are normally scheduled around 6:30 AM.

We also welcome families staying in Cabo San Lucas, Palmilla, the Tourist Corridor, and other Los Cabos areas.

Please remember that our boats depart from San José del Cabo, not Cabo San Lucas Marina.

Confirm your exact meeting point and departure time before your trip.

Frequently Asked Questions About Family Fishing Charters

Can children go fishing in San José del Cabo?

Yes, families with children can enjoy suitable private fishing charters. Boat availability, children's ages, safety equipment, and sea conditions must be confirmed before booking.

What is the best fishing trip for beginners?

A 6-hour private charter can be a good starting point, depending on the ages and preferences of your group. Our team can help you compare options.

Do we need previous fishing experience?

No. Beginners are welcome. Our local crew can explain basic fishing techniques and assist with the equipment.

Are family fishing charters private?

Yes. Every Exotic Fish Cabo charter is private and reserved for your group.

How much does family fishing cost?

Selected 6-hour private charters start at $350 USD per boat for 1–2 guests. Selected 8-hour trips start at $600 USD per boat. Final prices depend on the boat and group size.

Do you provide fishing equipment?

Yes. Standard fishing rods, reels, and basic tackle are included. Other inclusions vary by charter.

Can families staying in Cabo San Lucas book?

Yes. Guests staying anywhere in Los Cabos can book, but all our charters depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

Plan Your Family Fishing Adventure

A private fishing charter can be a memorable way to experience Los Cabos with your family.

At Exotic Fish Cabo, we'll help you compare boat options, choose a suitable trip duration, and understand what's included before you book.

Tell us your preferred date, the number of adults and children, and what kind of fishing experience you're looking for.
